summary_short.zh: Taste-Skill 是一套为 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程助手精心设计的技能集，旨在赋予 AI “好品味”，避免生成平庸、千篇一律的代码。它通过结构化的提示词和设计模式，引导 AI 产出更简洁、更具创意且贴合上下文的解决方案。开发者可将其作为自定义技能或提示模板集成，尤其适用于前端和设计任务，让 AI 生成的代码更有人情味和思考深度。这一项目展示了如何通过精细化的提示工程，将 AI 从“代码生成器”提升为“有品位的协作伙伴”，启发我们关注代码质量而非仅仅功能实现。

summaries.en: Taste-Skill is a curated skill set for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex that injects 'good taste' into generated code, preventing bland, generic outputs. It works by providing structured prompts and design patterns that guide the AI toward cleaner, more creative, and context-aware solutions. Developers can integrate it as a custom skill or prompt template to elevate code quality, especially in frontend and design tasks, making AI-generated code feel more human and thoughtful.
